description: Header file defining functions, constants, and documentation for radio operating standards management in a wireless device, including license info, function prototypes, and related documentation.

methods.name: wld_rad_update_operating_standard
methods.description: Updates the radio's operating standard based on provided parameters.

methods.name: wld_rad_getEnabledRadStd
methods.description: Returns a bitmask of enabled radio standards based on the supported list and user selection.

methods.name: wld_rad_checkEnabledRadStd
methods.description: Checks if a specific radio standard is enabled in the user's selection.

methods.name: wld_rad_handleOperStdsAndFormatNewValues
methods.description: Handles updates when both operating standards and their format parameters change.
